children: Bonk entered into a Securities Purchase Agreement with former Executive Chairman John Miklos Gulyas for a registered direct offering of 274,243 common shares at $0.36464 per share. Bonk plans to use the net proceeds for general corporate purposes, including working capital, capital expenditures and potential acquisitions.
